# Environment Setup & Path Configurations / 環境設定とパス構成

```{r paths_and_settings}
# ==============================================================================
# Path and Environment Configurations / パス・環境設定
# Read-only from shared drive, Write-only to local project directory
# 共有ドライブからは読み込みのみ、書き出しはローカルディレクトリのみ
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Primary path candidate (Local absolute path fallback for author's setup)
# 著者環境用フォールバック絶対パス
primary_vessel_path <- "/Users/oyamakei/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-keio@fisheries.agr.iwate-u.ac.jp/Shared drives/gakuLab_data/original/gfw/vessel_list/old/gfw_vessel_list_20250701.parquet"
primary_daily_dir   <- "/Users/oyamakei/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-keio@fisheries.agr.iwate-u.ac.jp/Shared drives/gakuLab_data/original/gfw/daily/fixed"

# 2. Get environment variable if available / 環境変数からの取得
gakulab_env_path <- Sys.getenv("GFW_MAIN_SHARE", unset = "")

# 3. Detect Vessel List File / Master船リストファイルの確定
if (file.exists(primary_vessel_path)) {
  VESSEL_LIST_FILE <- primary_vessel_path
} else if (nchar(gakulab_env_path) > 0) {
  vessel_search <- list.files(path = gakulab_env_path, pattern = "gfw_vessel_list_20250701\\.parquet$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  VESSEL_LIST_FILE <- vessel_search[1]
} else {
  VESSEL_LIST_FILE <- NA
}

# 4. Detect Daily Fixed Data Directory / 日次データフォルダの確定
if (dir.exists(primary_daily_dir)) {
  GFW_DAILY_DIR <- primary_daily_dir
} else if (nchar(gakulab_env_path) > 0) {
  daily_search <- list.dirs(path = gakulab_env_path, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  GFW_DAILY_DIR <- daily_search[str_detect(daily_search, "original/gfw/daily/fixed$")][1]
} else {
  GFW_DAILY_DIR <- NA
}

# File existence check / 事前存在チェック
if (is.na(VESSEL_LIST_FILE) || !file.exists(VESSEL_LIST_FILE)) {
  stop("Error: vessel_list file not accessible. / vessel_list ファイルにアクセスできません。")
}
if (is.na(GFW_DAILY_DIR) || !dir.exists(GFW_DAILY_DIR)) {
  stop("Error: daily/fixed directory not accessible. / daily/fixed ディレクトリにアクセスできません。")
}

# 5. Local Processed Directories / ローカルデータ保存先（プロジェクト直下）
local_processed_dir <- here("data", "processed")
local_daily_rus_dir <- here("data", "processed", "daily_russian_trawlers")

dir.create(local_processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(local_daily_rus_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Target Fishery Class / 分析対象漁種
fishery_type_temp <- c("trawlers")

# Base Path for Shapefiles / 共有ドライブのルートパス
gakulab_base_path <- dirname(dirname(dirname(dirname(VESSEL_LIST_FILE))))

message(paste0(">>> Vessel list path: ", VESSEL_LIST_FILE))
message(paste0(">>> Daily directory path: ", GFW_DAILY_DIR))
```

# Local Data Extraction & Subsetting / データ抽出とローカル保存

```{r step1_local_subsetting}
# ==============================================================================
# Step 1: Subsetting Russian Trawlers Data locally / ロシアトロール船データのローカル切り出し
# Skip if local Parquet files already exist / 既に手元にある場合は自動スキップ
# ==============================================================================
local_parquet_files <- list.files(local_daily_rus_dir, pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(local_parquet_files) == 0) {
  message(">>> [Local Processing] Extracting Russian trawlers data from shared drive...")
  
  # Load Vessel Master List / マスター船リストからロシアトロール船 ssvid を取得
  vessel_master <- read_parquet(VESSEL_LIST_FILE)
  
  target_ssvids <- vessel_master %>%
    filter(best_known_flag == "RUS", best_vessel_class %in% fishery_type_temp) %>%
    pull(ssvid) %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()
  
  message(paste0(">>> Target Russian Trawlers count: ", length(target_ssvids)))
  
  # Iterative Yearly Subsetting / 年別ループ切り出し
  for (y in 2018:2025) {
    yearly_files <- list.files(
      path       = GFW_DAILY_DIR,
      pattern    = paste0("^gfw_dat_v4_daily_", y, "_.*\\.parquet$"),
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(yearly_files) == 0) next
    
    # Exclude invalid/empty files / 破損・空ファイル（1KB以下）の除外
    valid_files <- yearly_files[file.info(yearly_files)$size > 1000]
    if (length(valid_files) == 0) next
    
    tryCatch({
      ds <- open_dataset(valid_files, format = "parquet")
      
      df_extracted <- ds %>%
        filter(ssvid %in% target_ssvids, fishing_hours > 0) %>%
        select(ssvid, first_timestamp, avg_lat_lon, active_hours, fishing_hours) %>%
        collect()
      
      if (nrow(df_extracted) == 0) next
      
      # Parse Lat/Lon with Regex / 正規表現による緯度経度抽出
      df_filt <- df_extracted %>%
        mutate(
          coords  = str_extract_all(avg_lat_lon, "[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+"),
          avg_lon = as.numeric(map_chr(coords, ~ .x[1])),
          avg_lat = as.numeric(map_chr(coords, ~ .x[2]))
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(avg_lat), !is.na(avg_lon),
          avg_lat >= 41.5, avg_lat <= 50.0,
          avg_lon >= 139.0, avg_lon <= 160.0
        ) %>%
        select(-coords)
      
      out_path <- file.path(local_daily_rus_dir, paste0("rus_trawlers_", y, ".parquet"))
      write_parquet(df_filt, sink = out_path)
      message(paste0(">>> Local extraction complete: Year ", y, " (", nrow(df_filt), " rows)"))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste0("!!! Error processing year ", y, ": ", e$message))
    })
  }
} else {
  message(">>> [Local Processing] Local subset Parquet files confirmed. Skipping extraction.")
}
```

# Spatial EEZ Intersection & Caching / EEZ空間結合とキャッシュ化

```{r step2_data_loading_and_caching}
# ==============================================================================
# Step 2: Spatial Intersection with EEZ & Cache / 空間結合とキャッシュ保存
# Apply distinct() to prevent duplication / 重複を排除してRDSキャッシュ
# ==============================================================================
cache_rds_path <- file.path(local_processed_dir, "russian_vessels_hokkaido_2018_2025.rds")

if (file.exists(cache_rds_path)) {
  message(">>> [Local Processing] Fast loading from local RDS cache.")
  dat_hokkaido <- readRDS(cache_rds_path)

} else {
  message(">>> [Local Processing] Executing EEZ spatial intersection...")
  
  # Load EEZ Boundaries / EEZポリゴンのロードと境界調整
  eez_files <- list.files(path = gakulab_base_path, pattern = "^eez_japan_comp\\.shp$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  eez_sf    <- st_read(eez_files[1], quiet = TRUE) |> st_make_valid()

  japan_around_sf  <- ne_countries(country = c('japan','russia','south korea','north korea','china'), scale = "large", returnclass = "sf") |> st_union() |> st_transform(crs = 4326)
  japan_true_sf    <- st_intersection(japan_around_sf, eez_sf)
  eez_japan_sea    <- st_difference(eez_sf, japan_true_sf)

  bbox_hokkaido    <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 139.0, xmax = 160.0, ymin = 41.5, ymax = 50.0), crs = st_crs(eez_japan_sea))
  eez_hokkaido_sea <- st_crop(eez_japan_sea, bbox_hokkaido)
  
  # Master list join / マスター情報の結合
  vessel_master <- read_parquet(VESSEL_LIST_FILE)
  
  # Load Local Parquet / ローカルParquetデータの統合
  local_files <- list.files(local_daily_rus_dir, pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
  ds_rus      <- open_dataset(local_files, format = "parquet")
  
  dat_raw <- ds_rus %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(
      ssvid    = as.character(ssvid),
      ts_posix = as.POSIXct(first_timestamp, tz = "Asia/Tokyo"),
      year     = year(ts_posix)
    ) %>%
    left_join(vessel_master, by = c("ssvid", "year"))
  
  # Precise Spatial Intersection with Deduplication / 空間結合と重複排除
  sf_raw <- dat_raw %>%
    mutate(lon = round(avg_lon, 2), lat = round(avg_lat, 2)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
  
  sf_hokkaido <- st_intersection(sf_raw, eez_hokkaido_sea) %>%
    distinct(ssvid, first_timestamp, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # Save clean dataset / キャッシュ用データ整形と書き出し
  dat_hokkaido <- sf_hokkaido %>%
    mutate(
      lon       = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
      lat       = st_coordinates(.)[,2],
      ts_posix  = as.POSIXct(first_timestamp, tz = "Asia/Tokyo"),
      year_num  = year(ts_posix),
      month_num = month(ts_posix),
      date      = as.Date(ts_posix)
    ) %>%
    select(-ts_posix) %>%
    st_drop_geometry()
  
  saveRDS(dat_hokkaido, cache_rds_path)
  message(">>> [Local Processing] Saved clean spatial cache RDS.")
}

# Common Spatial Object / 共通空間オブジェクト
sf_hokkaido <- st_as_sf(dat_hokkaido, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

# Descriptive Statistics Table / 記述統計表 (`gt`)

```{r gt_descriptive_statistics}
# ==============================================================================
# Step 3: Summary Statistics Table using `gt` / 年別記述統計表の生成
# Includes: Unique Vessels, Total Vessel-Days, Total Fishing & Active Hours
# 個別隻数、延べ隻数、総操業時間、総活動時間などを包含
# ==============================================================================

summary_gt_table <- dat_hokkaido %>%
  filter(best_known_flag == "RUS", best_vessel_class == "trawlers") %>%
  mutate(date_col = as.Date(first_timestamp)) %>%
  group_by(year_num) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_vessels        = n_distinct(ssvid),
    total_vessel_days     = n_distinct(paste0(ssvid, "_", date_col)),
    total_fishing_hours   = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_active_hours    = sum(active_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hours_per_vessel = total_fishing_hours / unique_vessels,
    .groups               = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Year = year_num) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "Annual Summary Statistics of Russian Trawlers in Hokkaido/Northern Territories EEZ",
    subtitle = "北海道・北方領土周辺EEZにおけるロシアトロール船の年別記述統計 (2018–2025)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Year                  = "Year / 年",
    unique_vessels        = "Unique Vessels / 個別隻数",
    total_vessel_days     = "Total Vessel-Days / 延べ隻数 (日)",
    total_fishing_hours   = "Total Fishing Hours / 総操業時間 (hr)",
    total_active_hours    = "Total Active Hours / 総活動時間 (hr)",
    mean_hours_per_vessel = "Mean Hours / 隻 / 1隻平均操業時間 (hr)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(unique_vessels, total_vessel_days),
    decimals = 0,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(total_fishing_hours, total_active_hours, mean_hours_per_vessel),
    decimals = 1,
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = c(total_fishing_hours),
    fn      = scales::col_numeric(palette = "Blues", domain = NULL)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.title.font.size    = px(16),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight  = "bold",
    table.border.top.style     = "solid",
    table.border.top.width     = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.style  = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width  = px(2)
  )

# Output gt Table / gtテーブルの出力
summary_gt_table
```

# Temporal Trend Analysis / 時系列トレンド分析

```{r plot_monthly_timeseries}
# ==============================================================================
# Step 4: Monthly Fishing Effort Timeseries / 月別総操業時間の推移描画
# ==============================================================================
monthly_summary <- dat_hokkaido %>%
  filter(best_known_flag == "RUS", best_vessel_class == "trawlers") %>%
  group_by(year_num, month_num) %>%
  summarise(
    total_fishing_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vessels           = n_distinct(ssvid),
    .groups             = "drop"
  )

ggplot(monthly_summary, aes(x = month_num, y = total_fishing_hours, color = factor(year_num), group = year_num)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title    = "Monthly Fishing Effort of Russian Trawlers (2018–2025)",
    subtitle = "ロシアトロール船の月別総操業時間推移",
    x        = "Month / 月",
    y        = "Total Fishing Hours / 総操業時間 (時間)",
    color    = "Year / 年"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Spatial Grid Analysis / 空間グリッド（メッシュ）解析

```{r spatial_grid_analysis}
# ==============================================================================
# Step 5: Spatial Grid Aggregation (0.1 x 0.1 degree) / 0.1度メッシュ解析
# Aggregating fishing effort into spatial grids / 空間グリッドへの操業努力量集計
# ==============================================================================

# Define Spatial Bounding Box & Cell Size (0.1 deg approx. 10km) / メッシュサイズ設定
grid_size <- 0.1

bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 139.0, xmax = 160.0, ymin = 41.5, ymax = 50.0), crs = st_crs(4326))
fish_grid <- st_make_grid(st_as_sfc(bbox), cellsize = c(grid_size, grid_size), square = TRUE) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number())

# Spatial join point data to grid cells / ポイントデータをグリッドへ割り当て
sf_trawlers <- sf_hokkaido %>% filter(best_known_flag == "RUS", best_vessel_class == "trawlers")

grid_summary <- st_join(fish_grid, sf_trawlers, join = st_contains) %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vessels   = n_distinct(ssvid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_hours > 0)

# Base Map Layer / 背景地図データの準備
land_sf <- ne_countries(country = c('japan', 'russia'), scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Plot Spatial Distribution Map / 空間努力量分布マップの表示
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_sf, fill = "gray90", color = "gray70") +
  geom_sf(data = grid_summary, aes(fill = total_hours), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno", 
    trans  = "log10", 
    labels = scales::comma,
    name   = "Fishing Hours\n(log10 scale)"
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(139.0, 155.0), ylim = c(41.5, 48.5), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = "Spatial Distribution of Russian Trawl Fishing Effort (2018–2025)",
    subtitle = "ロシアトロール船の累積操業時間空間分布 (0.1°グリッド集計)",
    x        = "Longitude / 経度",
    y        = "Latitude / 緯度"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95")
  )
```





```{r nemuro_straits_grid_analysis_005, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# ==============================================================================
# 根室海峡周辺の 0.05度グリッド集計 & 背景地図付き空間分布マップ
# ==============================================================================

# 1. 陸地データの取得
land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")

# 2. 根室海峡エリアの抽出 & 0.05度グリッドへの丸め処理（メッシュ化）
dat_nemuro_grid <- dat_hokkaido %>%
  filter(best_known_flag == "RUS", best_vessel_class == "trawlers") %>%
  filter(
    lon >= 144.8 & lon <= 146.0,
    lat >= 43.5  & lat <= 44.5
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 0.05度単位（約5km区画）でグリッド化
    grid_lon = round(lon / 0.05) * 0.05,
    grid_lat = round(lat / 0.05) * 0.05,
    month_num = month(first_timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5  ~ "春季 (3-5月)",
      month_num %in% 6:8  ~ "夏季 (6-8月)",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "秋季 (9-11月)",
      TRUE                ~ "冬季 (12-2月)"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("春季 (3-5月)", "夏季 (6-8月)", "秋季 (9-11月)", "冬季 (12-2月)"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(season, grid_lon, grid_lat) %>%
  summarise(total_fishing_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. 根室海峡のバウンディングボックス
nemuro_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 144.8, xmax = 146.0, ymin = 43.5, ymax = 44.5), crs = st_crs(4326))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 季節別 0.05度グリッドヒートマップの描画
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_nemuro_grid_map <- ggplot() +
  # 背景の陸地（グレー）
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "gray85", color = "gray60", size = 0.2) +
  # 0.05度メッシュのヒートマップ（width と height でセルサイズを指定）
  geom_tile(
    data = dat_nemuro_grid,
    aes(x = grid_lon, y = grid_lat, fill = total_fishing_hours),
    width = 0.05,
    height = 0.05,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "総操業時間 (hr)") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(nemuro_bbox["xmin"], nemuro_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(nemuro_bbox["ymin"], nemuro_bbox["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~season, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Grid Map of Russian Trawlers in Nemuro Strait (0.05° Mesh)",
    subtitle = "根室海峡周辺におけるロシアトロール船の季節別操業密度（0.05度メッシュ集計）",
    x = "経度 (Longitude)",
    y = "緯度 (Latitude)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_nemuro_grid_map)
```
